factCards.sourceTitle: Recording Academy, 65th Annual Grammy Awards results

factCards.text: Mind of Mine, released on RCA in March 2016, entered both the UK and US album charts at number one, and its lead single Pillowtalk topped both singles charts.
Louis Tomlinson's first release after the group was Just Hold On, a December 2016 collaboration with the producer Steve Aoki.
